deities: Mahalasa Narayani (Mohini, female avatar of Vishnu)

history.dynasty: Maratha-era structure built during Portuguese colonial rule in Goa
history.summary: The deity was originally at Verna (Old Mardol/Velham) in Salcette, South Goa; the temple there was destroyed by the Portuguese in 1567, but the idol was rescued and shifted to Mardol in Ponda, which lay outside Portuguese control. The present temple at Mardol was built in the 17th century and the idol reconsecrated there; some sources date the current edifice to the 18th century. The famous huge brass bell without a ringer was historically used as an instrument of justice, with testimonies after ringing it regarded as valid in court. The temple is famed for its seven-storey deepstambha lamp tower and copper-roofed main shrine. CSV town corrected from 'Ponda' to 'Mardol' (Mardol is a ward of Priol village in Ponda taluka, ~9 km from Ponda town). Opening hours vary across sources: official mahalasa.org lists 6:00 AM–9:00 PM daily; other sources report 6:00 AM–1:00 PM & 4:00–8:30 PM, 6:30 AM–8:30 PM, and 7:00 AM–8:30 PM (flagged as conflicting). Mahalasa is the kuladevata of Goud Saraswat Brahmins and Vaishnavas of Goa and South Canara.

name: Shri Mahalasa Narayani Temple
town_description: Mardol is a ward of Priol village in Ponda taluka, North Goa, about 9 km from Ponda town and 22 km from Panaji. Known as Sthalakutumban, it is rated one of the most beautiful temple sites in Goa, with the Mahalasa temple near the Mardol market.
tradition: Hindu (Vaishnava; kuladevata of Goud Saraswat Brahmins and Vaishnavas of Goa and South Canara)

travel.railway: Karmali on the Konkan Railway (nearest); Madgaon, Vasco da Gama
travel.road: On NH 4A bypass route between Panaji (22 km) and Ponda (9 km); well served by inter-state buses

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; the annual Zatra (January/February) is the most vibrant time
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM–9:00 PM daily per the temple's official site; other sources report split hours — verify before visiting
